主题：CRM Meeting Record Policy
Team,

When scheduling meetings from inbox requests, follow these rules:

EXCLUDED (do NOT schedule): Requests where ALL attendees are from our own @company.example.com domain. Internal-only syncs are tracked separately in the team calendar.

ELIGIBLE: Any meeting with at least one external attendee (non-@company.example.com email domain).

REQUIRED: For all eligible meetings, include the Salesforce contact ID in the calendar event description so we can link back to the CRM record. Use summary '<Account Name> - <Meeting Type>'.

- Ops Team"}
